subject: Note-decay C: corroboration threshold (RGMem θ_inf) — inject-eligible only after N independent observations
description:
Borrow RGMem's θ_inf. Forks off orch/feature/note-decay.

SCOPE: A freshly-recorded / curious_candidate note becomes INJECT-eligible (clears the gated-search inject bar) only after N independent observations corroborate it; single-shot noisy events stay sub-threshold and retrieval-quiet until corroborated. Add a corroboration counter on the note + threshold config (default N=3, tunable) and wire it into the context-need / inject gate (lib/context-gate.js + routes/graph.js gated path). Suppresses single-shot noise BEFORE it reaches the inject bar. Tests. Commit onto orch/attempt/<key> before complete_task.
